scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof stated with exact conditions. Sample computations are corroboration only. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The new equivalence is for positive integers, odd coefficients, and positive odd indices; no assertion is made about three consecutive powerful numbers, parameter density, or priority among unindexed earlier papers. Standard Pell and binomial lifting mechanisms are acknowledged.
title: Odd-power norm-two Pell lifting and powerful-number progressions
